open_points.subject: Unknown-reference refusal ownership and check location
open_points.text: "It gives the \"unknown reference\" refusal ..." and "Any operation's own checks or records; it decides only whether a request reaches an operation"
open_points.question: Which module performs existence checks that must fail as State 0 "unknown reference" before operation-specific checks: `surface` centrally, or each owning module as its first own check with `surface` only mapping the refusal?
options: Owning module checks existence first and returns a typed not-found refusal that `surface` passes through
open_points.default_guess: Owning module checks existence first; `surface` only normalizes/returns the refusal

open_points.subject: Actor field population for record writes
open_points.text: "Every record is written through `store`... Most record types have one writing module"
open_points.question: Who is the single owner of deriving and supplying `Actor` (`owner`/`agent`/`kernel`) values on every write path so K-15's per-record distinction is guaranteed consistently?
options: `surface` resolves request actor once and passes it through all calls; modules set only automatic `kernel` actor where rules say so
Each writing module derives actor from call context independently
open_points.default_guess: `surface` passes the caller actor explicitly; writing modules only choose `kernel` for automatic steps defined by rules
